scope: Base primary projectile material to soldier limb material; no gameplay changes. VSSM Standard and Range Pen raw projectiles additionally checked.
sourceBoundary: Raw grids and VSSM projectile assets read from the installed game on 12 September 2026 local time (13 September UTC). Existing weapon and soldier XML corpus is labelled 1.4.2.5; exact full-build identity is not independently established.
method: Read decompressed EBX streams, never call GetEbx/ReadAsset on a material grid.
Parse RIFF chunk and array directories with bounds checks; resolve relative array addresses against exact EBXX records.
Use SharedTypeDescriptors to identify object fields, strides and Float32 arrays.
Read each WB primary projectile with the existing extractor XPath, then its referenced projectile object MaterialDecl.Packed.
Use packed material upper 12 bits as material ID, then MaterialIndexMap and the two-dimensional interaction grid.
Follow material-relation lists to Class_c180226c / Field_7889231b float arrays.
The head-material array reproduces all 15 known headshot entries; limb records are singleton arrays.
Cross-check every resulting head/limb array in MP_Abbasid and MP_Badlands.
semanticBoundary: Class/field names are stripped. Identifying the c180226c array as damage protection is supported by the complete headshot table match, known control weapon limb values, and the operator VSSM observation. The native lookup function and single-element indexing/fallback implementation were not disassembled.
